title: Linear Equations in Two Variables
subtitle: Introduction and Graphical Representation
subject: Mathematics
author: Antigravity AI Content Engine
learning_outcomes: Identify and formulate linear equations in two variables.
Understand that a linear equation in two variables has infinitely many solutions.
Graph linear equations on a Cartesian coordinate plane.
Interpret equations of lines parallel to the x-axis and y-axis.

ai_context.learning_goal: Mastering the representation, formulation, and graphing of linear equations in two variables.
common_misconceptions: Assuming a linear equation in two variables has only one unique solution.
Confusing the x-intercept and y-intercept when graphing.
Misinterpreting the graphical representation of a linear equation as a curve instead of a straight line.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Always remind students that a straight line is made of infinite points, and every point on the line is a valid solution to the linear equation.
